purpose: Teach: 滞納/突発/陽性/観衆/空爆/同伴/中流/卓越

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療費の滞納事案を医療チームで丁寧に対応します
lines.en: Ren, we handle medical debt cases with careful attention across our entire medical team.
lines.style: Clear, steady opening. Composed professional tone. Even pacing, measured confidence. Direct eye contact. No condescension — speaking as colleague to peer.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、突発事故の救命を医療チームで備えております
lines.en: Yes, we train our medical team to respond to sudden emergencies with full readiness.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Slight pause before 'we train.' Steady, deliberate tempo. Voice carries the weight of responsibility without theatrics. Grounded presence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 検査結果が陽性の患者さんへの伝達方法を、貴院、慎重にされてますね、先生
lines.en: The way your hospital approaches telling patients about positive test results — you're very careful about that, aren't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, respectful observation. Slight hesitation before the question, genuine curiosity. Not testing — sincerely noting something he's witnessed. Soft lift at the end.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、観衆の中での救命対応も医療チームで訓練します
lines.en: Yes, we drill with our team to handle emergency response even in crowded situations.
lines.style: Calm restatement. Same measured pace as before. Slight emphasis on 'drill' — the concrete preparation behind the policy. No strain.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 空爆被害者の医療史を、貴院、研究されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital researches the medical histories of airstrike survivors, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Careful, almost tentative phrasing. Lower volume than before. Respectful acknowledgment of serious subject matter. Pause weight before 'doesn't it' — not interrogating, genuinely noting.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、付き添いの同伴者にも丁寧に対応します
lines.en: Yes, we make sure to give careful attention to the people accompanying patients as well.
lines.style: Consistent, grounded delivery. Slight warmth entering the voice — acknowledging the human dimension. Same professional composure, but the words land with care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 中流層に多い生活習慣病の予防を、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital works on preventing lifestyle diseases that are common in middle-income populations, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Observant, appreciative tone. Builds slightly on the previous question. Shows Ren connecting threads he's noticed. Respectful but gaining confidence in the conversation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療技術の卓越性を医療チームで追求します
lines.en: Yes, our medical team pursues excellence in medical technology and technique.
lines.style: Warm close. Slight drop in volume at the very end — a return to composure after dialogue. Genuine pride in the work, not boastful. Settling into quietness.
